Just one day after Fox News host Laura Ingraham cornered Vance on the administration’s response to last week’s air traffic nightmare, her colleague Brian Kilmeade went even further.

“He never should have been vice president,” Kilmeade said on his podcast Tuesday.

Kilmeade played a clip of Vance telling Ingraham that President Donald Trump’s war on Iran was not “a forever war,” and that he will, at some point, “finally” end it.

But Vance also complained that some people don’t want it to end.

“There are going to be people who demand more, who want the war to go on indefinitely,” Vance said.

Kilmeade was not impressed, calling it “another straw man” argument.

“I had to play this. It is so aggravating,” Kilmeade said of the Vance clip. “There’s not one person that I have ever met that wants an endless war, who will say the president’s gotta keep fighting no matter what.”

Kilmeade also called out Vance for the comments he made after Republicans were trounced in the midterm elections. The vice president said that “any honest conversation” about the defeat had to start with the Iran war.

Kilmeade was outraged.

“Really? So you’re telling me how I have to argue something and my beliefs? If I don’t argue the way you want me to, it’s not worth your time?” he asked.
